description: A web page of two CSS animations over a red bed. A translucent blue square slides right and turns a quarter (transform), and a yellow ring fades in (opacity). The page's clock is ours, so frame 0 has the square at the left and no ring, frame 15 has them halfway, and frame 29 almost at the end. Purple where the square crosses red is its 60% alpha surviving the capture and the decode. A full-frame white or black page means the transparent background was lost; a gray band naming the page means it was not captured at all.
